question.problem:
Let $D$ be a finite region enclosed by the curves $y=\frac{1}{2}{x}^{2}-1$ and $y=2-|x|.$ If $R=[-2,2]\times [-1,2],$ and

$$
{∬}_{D}x\operatorname{sin}⁡(x+y)\,\text{d}A={∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A,
$$

which of the following could be the definition of $f(x,y)?$

- ${\begin{aligned}x\operatorname{sin}⁡(x+y), & (x,y)\in D \\ 0, & (x,y)\notin D\end{aligned}$
- ${\begin{aligned}x\operatorname{sin}⁡(x+y), & (x,y)\in R \\ 0, & (x,y)\notin R\end{aligned}$
- ${\begin{aligned}x\operatorname{sin}⁡(x+y), & (x,y)\in D \\ 0, & (x,y)\in R∖D\end{aligned}$
